rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something holy or godlike.

example.english: This temple is very divine to me.
example.traditional: 呢座廟對我嚟講好神聖。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 miu2 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 hou2 san4 sing3

rows.note: Use this for exceptional skill, quality, or performance described as god-tier.

example.english: Their performance tonight was truly divine.
example.traditional: 佢今晚個演出真係神級。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 maan5 go3 jin2 ceot1 zan1 hai6 san4 kap1

rows.note: Use this attributively when something belongs to or comes from a god.

example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 gim3 hai6 san4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a person or appearance with an ethereally beautiful quality.

example.english: They look divine in a white dress.
example.traditional: 佢着白裙嗰陣好有仙氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 baak6 kwan4 go2 zan6 hou2 jau5 sin1 hei3
